phases.name: Technical feasibility validation
phases.goal: Validate WPS COM, ProgID fallback, conversion behavior, calculation fidelity, and HTML baseline before large-scale implementation.
exit_criteria: WPS component ProgID matrix is recorded
Minimal COM prototype can open, save a copy, and close documents
Spreadsheet calculation can be verified against displayed values
Conversion backend and loss matrix is documented
Go/no-go recommendation for Phase 1 is written

phases.name: MVP CLI
phases.goal: Deliver an Agent-callable CLI with document_id, backup, validation, dry-run, JSON protocol, and core WPS operations.

phases.name: Agent-ready scalable version
phases.goal: Add mature sessions, MCP reuse, batch operations, HTML modes, observability, and long-running task controls.

phases.name: Production-ready automation infrastructure
phases.goal: Strengthen recovery, security, performance, regression testing, and ecosystem integration.
exit_criteria: MET: cross-component conversion is verified between HTML and Office formats (Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation). HTML to DOCX opened and saved in WPS Writer (docs/archive/P3_HTML_EDITABLE_FIRST.md); HTML to XLSX and PPTX opened in WPS and exported back to HTML with content kept (scripts/real_wps_verify_remaining/RESULTS-4898428.md, section 4); DOCX, XLSX and PPTX to HTML verified locally (docs/CONVERSION_MATRIX.md). Structural editability on one WPS version; no visual-equivalence or cross-version claim

MET: mutations are atomic transactions; a change is either fully applied and verified or fully rolled back, with one exception below. A failed mutation is undone from its pre-write backup and the restored hash is checked (PR #15). Verified on Windows with the document closed: rollback performed, A1 back to the seed (scripts/real_wps_verify_remaining/RESULTS-4898428.md, section 1). The exception: while WPS holds the document open, the file lock refuses the automatic undo. The command then returns MUTATION_ROLLBACK_BLOCKED with the backup path and the steps to restore it (PR #30); the file keeps the rejected value until the user closes the document without saving and runs restore-backup. Verified on Windows: after the close, restore-backup returned ok and A1 was back to the seed (scripts/real_wps_verify_remaining/RESULTS-3a40da6.md, Case D). Documented in README, "修改失败与回滚"

MET: automated regression suite runs safe and WPS profiles with recorded artifacts. Windows run on main@b1a4b31 (2026-10-14): safe 7/7 (artifacts/regression/safe/regression-run-20261014T003140284929Z-0c8ae0f4-c225-48ba-b0ea-9db42b32a852.json), wps 4/4 (artifacts/regression/wps/regression-run-20261014T003207822953Z-b92e49b9-6389-482e-a069-230c2b5a23cf.json)
MET: a real Agent end-to-end evaluation pipeline runs and records results (scripts/agent_eval, PR #21, docs/AGENT_E2E_EVAL.md)
MET: ecosystem extension evaluation is written up (docs/ECOSYSTEM_EVALUATION.md, PR #22). Codex integration is tracked as a separate follow-up, not a condition for this criterion

phases.name: Multi-environment and agent workflow readiness
phases.goal: Prove the tools across WPS versions and agent clients, let agents complete real WPS write tasks safely with in-CLI recovery, and make the package releasable.
exit_criteria: E1: the three Phase 3 Windows checks are recorded (DOCUMENT_HELD_OPEN on real WPS, the held-document-backup agent-eval task, regression outputs under artifacts/regression/outputs)

E2: a compatibility matrix covers at least two WPS versions: the wps regression profile plus open, save and PDF/HTML export for all three components, per version, in docs/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md (2026-10-14: no second version was available, so per the plan's risk fallback this is one version, 12.8.2.18913, passing every check, with the missing second version recorded as a gap)

E3: the agent evaluation covers WPS write paths: at least four write tasks on Windows (spreadsheet write with verification, Writer replace, presentation replace, held-file refusal and recovery), each run three times and passing at least two, with pass rate, turns and tool calls recorded
E4: a second MCP client (Codex CLI or Claude Desktop) completes initialize, paginated tools/list and a safe tools/call, with client version, transport and negotiated protocol recorded

E5: a backup can be restored from the CLI while the document is open in WPS (the recovery a blocked rollback asks for), through an explicit opt-in that has WPS close the document without saving; the default never closes a user's document and unsaved WPS changes are refused; verified on Windows by the file hash matching the backup (docs/PHASE4_WINDOWS_RUNBOOK.md section 2, confirmed 2026-10-14)
E6: releasable: a versioning rule and CHANGELOG, a wheel built in CI, and a clean Windows install that follows the README and passes inspect-env and the safe regression profile

phases.name: First release and broader coverage
phases.goal: Make every tool failure visible to agents, widen the agent evaluation beyond the four write tasks, and publish a first release that works without the repository.
exit_criteria: F1: every one of the 85 MCP tools has an offline test that makes it fail and checks that the agent-facing result carries an error code (or a JSON-RPC argument error), never MCP_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED or an empty errors list; the tests run in CI and the problems they find are fixed

F2: the agent evaluation adds at least six tasks covering open-document reads and writes, HTML and Office conversion, Writer tables, sheet management and PDF export; each task names its expected tools and the runner reports calls outside them; tasks that need WPS pass at least 2 of 3 runs on Windows (2026-10-15: seven tasks, all 3/3; wps-open-document-export-text ran with the /Automation open command in three separate invocations, accepted as an exception, and the limit it found is P5-011)

F3: the first release is published: version set by docs/RELEASING.md, tagged, with the wheel and sdist attached to a GitHub Release; in a new virtual environment with only that wheel installed, inspect-env and the safe regression profile pass (2026-10-14: v0.2.0 released; 2026-10-15: the Release wheel passed inspect-env and safe 7/7 on Windows)
F4: the repository is formatted with ruff format once and CI checks formatting

phases.name: Documents the user opened
phases.goal: Make the open-document tools work on documents the user opened the usual way, or say clearly when they cannot; prove agents can write to open documents; and release it as 0.3.0.
exit_criteria: G1: on Windows, for each of Writer, Spreadsheets and Presentation, a document opened by double-click with the stock open command is either listed by open-documents and exported by export-open-document-text, or the commands return a dedicated error code whose message gives the cause and what the user can do, never 'no running WPS'; both outcomes have offline fake-COM tests and the Windows results are recorded (2026-10-15: all three components listed through the Running Object Table and exported, P6-004)

G2: the agent evaluation adds at least four open-document write tasks (Writer selection replace, Writer selection insert, Presentation selection replace, save_open_document), each naming its expected tools; the WPS open-document tasks, including wps-open-document-export-text, pass at least 2 of 3 runs on Windows in one --repeat 3 invocation without changing the system open command (2026-10-15: all five 3/3 on main@4ba838b, after fixing the open-document backup probe and the presentation read-back)

G3: v0.3.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md with the G1 and G2 changes; in a new Windows virtual environment with only that wheel installed, inspect-env and the safe regression profile pass (2026-10-15: v0.3.0 released from main@b19d201; the Release wheel passed inspect-env and safe 7/7 on Windows, P6-010)

phases.name: Open-document writes: undo in WPS and full coverage
phases.goal: Undo a failed open-document write inside WPS instead of a blocked file rollback, evaluate every open-document write command on Windows, run the Windows checks with one command, and release 0.4.0.
exit_criteria: H1: when one of the 8 open-document selection writes has changed the document in WPS and a later check fails, the command undoes the change in the same WPS instance, reads it back and reports rolled_back_in_wps, never MUTATION_ROLLBACK_BLOCKED because WPS holds the file; if the undo itself fails, a dedicated error code says what state the document is in and what to do, and the user's document is not closed or saved; fake-COM tests per component and an in-process injected read-back failure verified on Windows for Writer and Presentation (2026-10-15: undo 2/2 on Windows for Writer and Presentation on main@564d103 and again on 1c460da: VALIDATION_FAILED then MUTATION_ROLLED_BACK, rolled_back_in_wps true, content matches the backup, never MUTATION_ROLLBACK_BLOCKED)

H2: at least five new agent-eval tasks cover at least five of writer_selection_delete, presentation_selection_insert, presentation_selection_delete, spreadsheet_selection_replace, spreadsheet_selection_delete and save_as_open_document, each naming its expected tools; all WPS open-document tasks pass at least 2 of 3 runs on Windows in one --repeat 3 invocation without changing the system open command (2026-10-16: six new tasks cover all six commands; all 11 open-document tasks 3/3 in one --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 invocation on main@0f5d8ee, resumed twice with --resume after the session ended; earlier rounds found and fixed garbled PowerShell output, the MCP server's GBK stdin and WPS's recovery instance of et.exe)

H3: one script runs the Windows checks: prerequisites (claude answers, no leftover WPS processes, open command unchanged, commit), then the requested evaluation or wheel check, and writes the results file in the repository's format; the H1, H2 and H4 Windows results come from it (2026-10-16: scripts/windows_check/run_windows_check.py wrote every Phase 7 Windows result: undo, eval and wheel)

H4: v0.4.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md with the H1 and H2 changes, the tag pushed only after __version__ and CHANGELOG.md are on main; in a new Windows virtual environment with only that wheel installed, inspect-env and the safe regression profile pass, checked with the H3 script (2026-10-15: v0.4.0 released from main@564d103; its wheel passed all seven conditions on Windows with run_windows_check.py wheel, safe 7/7, P7-009)

phases.name: Chinese content and workbooks opened the usual way
phases.goal: Make Chinese content work end to end and close workbooks the user opened the usual way: test every path non-ASCII text takes, evaluate Chinese tasks on Windows, fix or explain the failing workbook close, and release 0.4.1 and 0.5.0.
exit_criteria: I1: offline, real-process tests under a GBK locale show Chinese paths, document names, written text and sheet names reach the CLI and MCP server unchanged and come back unchanged, and each PowerShell component (Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation) has a fake-COM round trip of Chinese text; on Windows at least four new agent-eval tasks with Chinese content pass at least 2 of 3 runs in one --repeat 3 invocation (2026-10-16: tests/test_chinese_text.py, P8-003; all four wps-open-zh-* tasks 3/3 in one --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 invocation on main@1c44940, after the first run found the text export rejecting GBK output, fixed in #100)

I2: close_unchanged_document closes a workbook reached through the Running Object Table and confirms WPS no longer lists it, and restore-backup --close-in-wps closes and restores a double-clicked workbook on Windows; if that cannot be made to work, a dedicated error code gives the cause and what to do, verified on Windows (2026-10-16: run_windows_check.py close-diag closed a double-clicked workbook with every method on main@4731b04, untouched, and on aed06e6 after a write saved by another process, where restore-backup --close-in-wps closed and restored it; P7-007's 0x800A01A8 did not reproduce, the close stays Close(), and WPS_CLOSE_REFUSED is the fallback)

I3: v0.4.1 is released first with the fixes already in [Unreleased], and v0.5.0 at the end with the I1 and I2 changes, per docs/RELEASING.md; each wheel is checked on Windows with run_windows_check.py wheel (2026-10-16: v0.4.1 and v0.5.0 released; both wheels passed all seven conditions on Windows, safe 7/7, P8-002 on main@4731b04 and P8-010 on e4ae8c3)

phases.name: Right tools, lossless text export, clean Windows runs
phases.goal: Make agents pick the open-document tools, keep every character in text exports, and end the Windows runs' WPS cleanly so no manual cleanup is needed; release 0.6.0.
exit_criteria: J1: offline, every file-based write tool refused on a document open in WPS names the matching open-document tool and how its arguments map, the MCP descriptions of those tools say they are not for documents open in WPS, and each evaluation run records wrong_tool_calls (file-based write calls on an open document), shown in RESULTS.md; on Windows all open-document tasks (the existing 15 plus the J2 task) pass at least 2 of 3 runs in one --repeat 3 invocation with wrong_tool_calls summing to 0 (2026-10-16: on main@edb577c, all 16 open-document tasks 3/3 in one --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 invocation with wrong_tool_calls 0; in P8-008 an agent had called presentation_replace on an open presentation)

J2: export-open-document-text writes Unicode (UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a byte order mark) for Writer and Spreadsheets, keeping characters outside GBK, and records export_method and text_encoding; fake-COM tests per component; on Windows a new task exporting an open document with characters outside GBK passes at least 2 of 3 runs in the J1 invocation, with no text_encoding of gbk (2026-10-16: wps-open-zh-document-export-beyond-gbk 3/3 on main@edb577c, text_encoding utf-8 in every run, ✅ and 𠮷 kept)

J3: the runner's cleanup closes the documents it opened and ends the WPS it started with Quit(), stopping the process only when Quit() fails, and says which in cleanup; on Windows, after one cleanup before the run, every run of the J1 invocation has an empty documents_outside and no process was stopped while WPS still had a document open (2026-10-16: all 48 runs on main@edb577c ended WPS normally, cleanup exited (main window closed), none stopped; documents_outside empty in every run)

J4: v0.6.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md with the J1 and J2 changes, and its wheel is checked on Windows with run_windows_check.py wheel (2026-10-16: v0.6.0 released from main@edb577c; its wheel passed all seven conditions on Windows, safe 7/7, P9-008)

phases.name: Self-verifying write results, undoable chart and shape writes
phases.goal: Make open-document write results carry the verified document state so agents stop re-checking, undo failed chart and shape selection writes in WPS, and release 0.7.0.
exit_criteria: K1: offline, every open-document write command (Writer, Presentation and Spreadsheet selection replace, insert and delete, save, save-as and text export) returns verified_state, the content read back from the saved file that shows the write is right (the whole paragraph or text box for Writer and Presentation, the sheet name and written range values for Spreadsheets) and a sentence on what was checked, and the MCP descriptions of these tools say the result is already verified; on Windows all 16 open-document tasks pass at least 2 of 3 runs in one --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 invocation with wrong_tool_calls summing to 0 and off_path_calls summing to at most 20 (50 in P9-006) (2026-10-17: met on main@ab92a42, all 16 tasks 3/3, wrong_tool_calls 0, off_path_calls 11 of which 8 after the write, P10-006)

K2: offline, Spreadsheet selection replace and delete on shape text, chart titles, axis titles and series values record the original value before writing and, when the read-back fails, write it back in WPS, save and read back again, reporting rolled_back_in_wps, returning MUTATION_ROLLBACK_IN_WPS_FAILED only when that fails; fake-COM tests per object kind; on Windows run_windows_check.py undo gains shape-text and chart-title cases and after an injected read-back failure both WPS and the file are back to the state before the write (2026-10-17: met on main@9c5a009, undo 4/4 including spreadsheet-shape-text-replace and spreadsheet-chart-title-replace, rolled back in WPS with content matching the backup; the first run on ab92a42 refused both before the write because the selection read took a text box and a chart title for a series, fixed in #107)

K3: v0.7.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md with the K1 and K2 changes, and its wheel is checked on Windows with run_windows_check.py wheel (2026-10-17: v0.7.0 released from main@ab92a42; its wheel passed all seven conditions on Windows, safe 7/7, P10-008); the #107 selection fix came after the tag and is in [Unreleased]

phases.name: Ship the selection fix, spreadsheet writes with their surroundings, full undo coverage
phases.goal: Ship the selection fix 0.7.0 lacks in 0.8.0, make spreadsheet write results show the cells around the write so agents stop re-reading them, cover axis title and series undo on Windows, and release 0.8.0.
exit_criteria: L1: the next release, 0.8.0, includes the #107 selection fix, and its CHANGELOG entry says 0.7.0 has the defect; checked on Windows with the L4 wheel check (decided 2026-10-17: no separate 0.7.1, because the phase's changes go in one commit) (2026-10-17: met, v0.8.0 released from main@4ccd565 with the #107 and #110 fixes; its wheel passed all seven conditions on Windows, P11-009)

L2: offline, spreadsheet selection replace and delete return verified_state.surroundings, the cells around the written range read from the saved file (one row and column on each side plus the header row, at most 10 by 10) with each value and whether it changed, and the check sentence says the surroundings did not change; each evaluation run records the verified_state each write tool returned and RESULTS.md lists writes whose passed is not true; on Windows all 16 open-document tasks pass at least 2 of 3 runs in one --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 invocation with wrong_tool_calls 0, off_path_calls_after_write summing to at most 3 (8 in P10-006), and every write's verified_state.passed true (2026-10-17: met on main@20c94d8, all 16 tasks 3/3, wrong_tool_calls 0, off_path_calls 4 of which 3 after the write, unverified_writes 0, P11-007)

L3: run_windows_check.py undo gains axis-title and series-values replace scenarios (the fixture chart has an axis title and a series linked to cells), and after the undo the text of shapes and charts and the cells the series refers to are back to before the write; on Windows undo passes 6 of 6 (2026-10-17: met on main@4ccd565, undo 6/6; the first run on 20c94d8 refused the series scenario before the write because the series write scripts named the selection after the chart itself, fixed in #110)

L4: v0.8.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md with the L2 and L3 changes, and its wheel is checked on Windows (2026-10-17: v0.8.0 released from main@4ccd565; its wheel passed all seven conditions on Windows, safe 7/7, P11-009)

phases.name: Full evaluation, a clean environment and PyPI, ready for 1.0
phases.goal: Rerun every evaluation task on the current version, install and check from scratch on a Windows account that never ran the project, publish to PyPI, write down the public interface and its stability rules, and release 0.9.0.
exit_criteria: M1: on Windows one run_windows_check.py eval --repeat 3 --min-passes 2 without --prefix (all 34 tasks) on the phase's main passes every task at least 2 of 3 runs with wrong_tool_calls 0 and unverified_writes 0; tasks that fail are fixed in the phase and rerun

M2: on a Windows account that never ran the project, with WPS installed as the default app, pip install wps-ai-agent-cli==0.9.0 from PyPI passes inspect-env, compatibility checks C1 to C6 and run_windows_check.py undo 6 of 6, recorded in docs/COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.md

M3: offline, the release workflow uploads the same wheel and sdist to PyPI with Trusted Publishing after the GitHub Release, and run_windows_check.py wheel gains --source pypi, which installs from PyPI and checks the SHA-256 against the GitHub Release; on Windows wheel --version 0.9.0 --source pypi passes

M4: offline, a generated inventory of the public interface (CLI commands and arguments, MCP tools and parameters, error codes, top-level data fields per command) is committed, a test fails when the interface changes without the inventory, and docs/RELEASING.md states the stability rules before and after 1.0 and a 1.0 checklist
M5: v0.9.0 is released per docs/RELEASING.md on GitHub and PyPI with the phase's changes and the M1 fixes, and its wheel is checked on Windows
